aboutGame.title: What is Ebbtide?
paragraphs: Ebbtide is a single-player zombie survival real-time strategy game from ProjectAlive. Set in a collapsing Los Angeles, it puts you in command of the last carrier task force and asks you to rescue survivors while holding ground against massive zombie hordes.

You can fight directly as a survivor on the ground, then pull back to an overhead command view to direct infantry squads, M2 Abrams tanks, AH-6M Little Bird helicopters, and artillery. Forward operating bases, rooftop defenses, evacuation routes, and layered fallback positions turn each operation into a contest of positioning and supply.

modules.name: Ebbtide Beginner Guide
modules.description: Learn the core loop: command a carrier task force, rescue survivors, manage military units, and hold Los Angeles against large zombie hordes.

highlights.detail: Learn the two-view loop: fight as a survivor, then pull back to command squads.
Secure a production foothold and a small flexible squad before expanding.
Place a forward operating base with room to expand and a clear retreat route.
Build defenses in layers and hold at least one rooftop firing position.
Treat hordes as sustained pressure: rotate damaged units and bank repair resources.
Revisit your build order after each engagement instead of repeating a failed layout.

modules.name: Ebbtide Gameplay and Features
modules.description: See how Ebbtide combines direct survivor combat, real-time squad command, base building, armored vehicles, air support, and artillery.

highlights.label: Two Views
highlights.detail: Switch between direct survivor control and an overhead command view to read and shape the battle.

highlights.label: Squads
highlights.detail: Order infantry groups to screen armor, hold ground, and cover exposed flanks.

highlights.label: FOBs
highlights.detail: Forward operating bases shorten reinforcement routes and extend pressure into contested blocks.

highlights.label: Armor
highlights.detail: M2 Abrams tanks anchor lanes and absorb horde pressure when infantry screen their hulls.

highlights.label: Air
highlights.detail: AH-6M Little Bird helicopters handle fast response, extraction, and short precision sorties.

highlights.label: Artillery
highlights.detail: Called-in strikes break up dense clusters before they reach your defensive line.

modules.name: Ebbtide Units and Military Vehicles
modules.description: Compare the documented battlefield roles of artillery, M2 Abrams tanks, AH-6M Little Bird helicopters, and forward operating bases.

highlights.label: S
highlights.detail: Artillery: break up dense horde clusters before contact and fire at density peaks.

highlights.label: A
highlights.detail: M2 Abrams: anchor a defensive lane, absorb pressure, and rotate damaged armor for repair.

highlights.label: B
highlights.detail: AH-6M Little Bird: strike fast, break contact early, and pair with ground eyes.

highlights.label: C
highlights.detail: Forward Base: extend reach and shorten reinforcement distance once the first line holds.

modules.name: Ebbtide Combat Strategy Guide
modules.description: Coordinate production, force composition, evacuation corridors, and fire support while defending against escalating zombie pressure.

highlights.detail: Secure a production foothold and a small flexible squad before building wide.
Extend map control with a forward operating base and scouted approach routes.
Build layered defenses and repair capacity before the first large wave.
Keep mobile reserves ready and fire artillery at density peaks on approach.
Protect evacuation corridors and hold at least one elevated firing position.
Fall back, consolidate, and counterattack instead of feeding units into a collapsing lane.

modules.name: Ebbtide Base Building and Defense
modules.description: Plan defensive depth, forward operating bases, rooftop firing positions, vehicle staging areas, and fallback lines against sustained attacks.

highlights.label: Perimeter
highlights.detail: Turn open ground into a kill zone with overlapping defensive arcs.

highlights.label: FOB
highlights.detail: Place forward operating bases where reinforcements can arrive and units can retreat.

highlights.label: Rooftops
highlights.detail: Use elevated firing positions to multiply effective force and cover street approaches.

highlights.label: Staging
highlights.detail: Keep armor repaired and ready at a vehicle staging area near the line.

highlights.label: Fallback
highlights.detail: Build a second line so one breach does not become a total collapse.

highlights.label: Layers
highlights.detail: Build in depth rather than a single wall that fails at one point.

highlights.detail: Stabilize the Los Angeles beachhead and establish a production foothold.
Rescue and escort civilians while keeping evacuation corridors open.
Secure supply routes and forward operating bases to sustain each push.
Expand from city operations toward support for other regions.
Carry the same combined-arms discipline into larger campaign operations.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers about Ebbtide, its release status, platforms, combat loop, units, and beginner priorities.

items.question: What is Ebbtide?
items.answer: Ebbtide is a single-player zombie survival real-time strategy game from ProjectAlive. It is set in a collapsing Los Angeles, where you command the last carrier task force, rescue survivors, and defend against massive zombie hordes.

items.question: When does Ebbtide release?
items.answer: Ebbtide is listed as Coming Soon on Steam. ProjectAlive has not announced a launch date or price.

items.question: Which platforms will Ebbtide support?
items.answer: Ebbtide is listed for Windows and macOS. The Steam page also confirms single-player support and Family Sharing.

items.question: What is the core Ebbtide gameplay loop?
items.answer: You fight as a survivor on the ground, switch to an overhead command view to direct squads and fire support, and build forward operating bases between horde attacks.

items.question: Which Ebbtide units are confirmed?
items.answer: Official footage and store details have shown infantry, M2 Abrams tanks, AH-6M Little Bird helicopters, forward operating bases, and artillery.

items.question: How should beginners start Ebbtide?
items.answer: Start with the Ebbtide Beginner Guide: secure production, keep one flexible squad, build defenses in layers, and avoid overextending before the first major horde.
